[P2] Contain plugin worker startup failures

If `Thread.start()` raises, for example because the process reaches its thread limit, this exception escapes into `ExecutionState.checkpoint_batches_forever()`. That converts an already successful checkpoint into `BackgroundThreadError` and aborts the invocation solely because instrumentation could not start. Catch worker startup failures, log them, and disable queued dispatch for that invocation without failing checkpoint processing. Add a regression test covering a successful checkpoint when worker startup raises.
